title: Product Weyl--Heisenberg covariant mutually unbiased bases and extremal non-stabilizerness
summary: Discrete structures in product Hilbert spaces are investigated. For monopartite systems of size $d$ one relies on the Weyl--Heisenberg group $WH(d)$, while in the case of composite Hilbert spaces with the local dimensions $d_i$ we identify designs covariant with respect to the product group, $\bigotimes_i WH(d_i)$. In analogy with magic -- a quantity attaining its maximum for states fiducial with respect to $WH(d)$ -- we introduce a similar quantifier of {\sl product magic}, defined with respect to the product group.
